title: Bee Removal in Prince's Bay, Staten Island
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Prince's Bay, Staten Island. Licensed nest treatment and entry-point sealing — (855) 930-5016.
intro: Prince's Bay residents know that wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, and carpenter bees can pose serious risks when they establish nests near homes, businesses, or recreational areas. The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional stinging-insect nest treatment and removal throughout Prince's Bay — locating the nest, treating the colony, removing accessible nest material, and sealing entry points to prevent recolonization. Our licensed technicians respond quickly to active nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, eaves, and wood structures, ensuring your family and neighbors remain safe.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Prince's Bay for years with reliable, affordable bee removal services tailored to Staten Island's unique coastal environment. Our licensed professionals use eco-friendly methods and provide transparent pricing from $350 to $550, with no hidden fees.
localContext: Prince's Bay's waterfront properties, historic homes near Lemon Creek, and family residences along Seguine Avenue often attract wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets seeking sheltered nesting sites in eaves, chimneys, soffits, and wall voids. Carpenter bees bore into the wooden trim and siding common on older homes in the neighborhood. The proximity to Conference House Park and the area's abundant gardens create ideal foraging territory for ground-nesting yellow jackets and paper wasps, with nest activity peaking during spring and summer months. Honeybee colonies found during inspection are referred to a licensed beekeeper.

faqs.question: How quickly can you treat a wasp or hornet nest in Prince's Bay?
faqs.answer: We typically respond to Prince's Bay stinging-insect calls within 24 hours. Same-day service is often available for aggressive nests or situations involving children, pets, or allergic individuals. Once on-site, most wasp and hornet nest treatments are completed within 1–3 hours depending on nest location and access — wall-void nests take longer than exposed paper nests.

faqs.question: What does bee and wasp removal cost in Prince's Bay?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins. Wall-void nests, attic nests, and second-story locations require more time and equipment than ground nests or exposed paper nests under eaves.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Prince's Bay?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves. Most calls for stinging insects in wall voids, soffits, and eaves turn out to be yellow jackets, paper wasps, or bald-faced hornets — those we treat and remove.

faqs.question: Will wasps or yellow jackets return after the nest is treated?
faqs.answer: Our wasp and hornet removal service includes treating the nest, removing accessible nest material, and sealing every entry point to prevent recolonization. We also identify attractants and provide recommendations for property modifications to make your Prince's Bay home less attractive to future nesting. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
